install_contract.owned_prefix: Use a fresh owned absolute prefix, with every Rust component installed into that same prefix in listed order. No sudo, rustup or host-wide configuration.
install_contract.no_docs: Individual selected component archives contain no rust-docs component. Require their components files to match component_file_must_equal; do not install arbitrary extra components.
install_contract.explicit_path: Prepend owned_prefix/bin before all inherited tool paths. Invoke owned_prefix/bin/cargo explicitly. Set RUSTC and RUSTDOC to the installed real binaries and require command lookup of rustc, cargo, rustfmt, cargo-fmt and cargo-clippy to resolve under owned_prefix/bin. Record rustc --print sysroot and actual tool versions before any build.
install_contract.archive_safety: Before executing install.sh, verify exact bytes/SHA, reject absolute or escaping member paths, reject links resolving outside extraction root, and retain internal links only if the safe extractor supports them. Abort on missing/ambiguous expected executable or components. No filename-only fallback bypasses digest checks.
install_contract.python: Ubuntu 24.04 system Python 3.12 satisfies both project >=3.10 requirements; set ordinary formatter launcher to python3 and use that interpreter for uv environments, with no separate Python download.
install_contract.native_tests: No native compilation/execution happened in this prerequisite preparation. Runner must independently prove resolved normal/build closure excludes v8 before compiling; no RustyV8 download is provisioned.

alternate_full_rust_archive.reason: Explicit components avoid documentation and unrelated bundled tools. Official dist source includes rustfmt and Clippy in combined installer; rust-src still requires its separate archive.
